props.name: title
props.description: Shorthand: renders a CardHeader with a CardTitle before the children.

props.name: meta
props.description: Shorthand: a muted line under the title, inside the header.

props.name: href
props.description: With `interactive`, renders the card as a link to this URL.

components.name: CardMedia
components.description: Image, video, or embed. Pass an ,

components.name: CardMediaOverlay
components.description: Sits on top of CardMedia, e.g. a play button or a video duration.

components.name: CardThumbnail
components.description: Small square image beside the content. Wrap the text in CardMain.

examples.title: interactive href
examples.code:
<Card
  interactive
  href="#card"
  title="Go to reports"
  meta="Renders as a link"
/>

examples.title: media right, inset
imports: import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardMain, CardMedia, CardTitle } from "@/components/standard/card"
examples.code:
<Card>
  <CardMedia position="right" inset>
    <div className="size-full bg-linear-to-br from-sky-400 to-violet-500" />
  </CardMedia>
  <CardMain className="justify-center">
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Color</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Put the media on either side.</CardBody>
  </CardMain>
</Card>

examples.title: left and right panels
imports: import { Card, CardBody, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardLeft, CardMain, CardRight, CardTitle } from "@/components/standard/card"
examples.code:
<Card>
  <CardLeft>Left</CardLeft>
  <CardMain>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Crew</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Panels run the full height, like columns.</CardBody>
    <CardFooter>Footer</CardFooter>
  </CardMain>
  <CardRight>Right</CardRight>
</Card>
